settings.discretisation: plane-wave Galerkin on fractional grid; psi coefficients on the inscribed disc |G| < pi N/a of the N x N FFT box; products on a 2N x 2N grid (exact, no aliasing)
settings.ground_state_solver: preconditioned L-BFGS on E with normalisation by scaling (only from far seeds), then Newton-Krylov (projected PCG on the constrained Hessian) to ||H psi - mu psi||/||psi|| < 1e-11
settings.astar: bounded Brent on e(a)=E_cell/A at rho=1, xatol = 1e-7 a; cross-checks: 5-point quartic fit, envelope-theorem de/da root
settings.bdg: dense plane waves |q+G| < Kcut, Cholesky route A = C C^T, K = C^T L C, full spectrum; mirror parity blocks; chi_static by matrix-free FFT CG in the same basis
